# AppleMultitouchSPI

L'extension du noyau qui parle au contrôleur tactile par SPI.

Chaque entrée est une fonction ou une table lue dans le binaire décompilé. Elle consigne ce qui a été lu, avec son statut ; aucun code d'Apple n'est stocké ici. Les notes elles-mêmes sont rédigées en anglais.

## AppleMultitouchSPI::bootloadTimerFiredHandler()

Point d'entrée `0x8056e2c0` · Relecture : partielle · 2 affirmations · 2 questions ouvertes

- **MT-BOOT-001** (device disassembly verified): The bootload timer handler returns without acting if the PowerOnly flag (byte this+0x7d4) is set or if the byte this+0x7d2 is set.
- **MT-BOOT-002** (device disassembly verified): The routine at 0x8056e5d8 ("Checking if bootloaded (getting report info)") calls slot 0x3e8 with the report code 0xD3 and a four-byte buffer and returns whether the call succeeded.

- *Ouverte* **MT-BOOT-Q1**: Body of the bootload method itself (virtual slot 0x378 of the driver class, called up to three times), which sends the firmware: its packet format, its source and its size were not found; the strings 'PreconstructedBootloadPacket…
- *Ouverte* **MT-BOOT-Q2**: Slots 0x350, 0x364, 0x37c, 0x39c, 0x3e8 and 0x3fc used by this flow (check bootloaded, disable or enable the interrupt, 'device has firmware' path, cache the device properties, get report info, and a state setter): only their use…

[Fiche complète](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/blob/main/tools/iop_analysis/catalog/AppleMultitouchSPI/bootload_flow_0x8056e2c0.yaml)

## bootloader check (CHECK packet)

Point d'entrée `0x8056e4e8` · Relecture : complète · 2 affirmations · 3 questions ouvertes

- **MT-CHECK-001** (device disassembly verified): Builds a four-byte packet on the stack with the bytes 05 00 00 06 (offsets 0 to 3), logs "Sending CHECK packet, to see if device is in bootloader", and sends it through the SPI device object at this+0x54 with a four-byte receive…
- **MT-CHECK-002** (device disassembly verified): The exchange is the call of slot 0x368 on the SPI device object (this+0x54) with the transmit buffer (the four packet bytes), a length of 4, a four-byte receive buffer, a receive length of 4 and a zero flag.

- *Ouverte* **MT-CHECK-Q1**: Whether the N1 class used for the n88 node calls this routine: it sits in the shared kext, and the N1 personality matches a class of the same kext, but the call chain from AppleMultitouchN1SPI was not traced.
- *Ouverte* **MT-CHECK-Q2**: Body of slot 0x368 of the SPI device object (the call that performs the exchange, with the arguments listed in MT-CHECK-002): it reads as the transfer by its arguments, but its body is in the platform kext and was not read.
- *Ouverte* **MT-CHECK-Q3**: The checksum or framing of the 4 bytes (05 00 00 06): the last byte may be a checksum of the first three plus one, unverified.

[Fiche complète](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/blob/main/tools/iop_analysis/catalog/AppleMultitouchSPI/check_packet_0x8056e4e8.yaml)
